scenes.heading: Blank, Idle, Clear
scenes.say: Blank, Idle and Clear. How to keep the screen calm.

scenes.heading: Blank: the full stop
scenes.say: Press the full stop key, or Blank under Next, and the screen goes black at once. Press it again, or tap Blank again, and the slide comes back where it was.

scenes.heading: Idle: the waiting screen
scenes.say: Idle, the first tile under Next, puts up your idle screen, usually the church's logo, without closing the service. The comma key does the same. Use it in the gaps between items. Tap Idle again to bring the slide back, or press Space to carry on.

scenes.heading: Which one?
items: Idle: the waiting screen, for gaps
Clear text: hides the words, keeps the picture
Tap it again: back to the slide
scenes.say: Blank puts up black. Idle puts up the waiting screen, for gaps between items. Clear text hides the words but keeps the background. All three are tiles under Next, in the same order as their keys: comma, full stop and semicolon. Tapping Idle or Blank again brings the slide back.
If anything goes wrong, a wrong slide, a typo, anything at all: blank first, then think. Nobody minds a black screen for a moment.

scenes.heading: Try each one
scenes.action: On the sermon deck that comes next
scenes.say: Try each one on the sermon deck that comes next. Press Space to start it.
